dataset_name: Door - heroal-Johann Henkenjohann GmbH & Co. KG - Aluminium fire door (EN 15804+A2)
Use advice for data set: This dataset is modelled according to the European Standard EN 15804 for Sustainable Construction. Results are declared in modules, which allow the structured expression of results throughout the life cycle. It contains the modules A1-A3, A4, A5, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7, C1, C2, C3, C4, D. The comparison with other products is only permissible if the application in the building is comparable. A comparison or the evaluation of EPD data is only possible, if the datasets have been created according to EN 15804. The building context or the product-specific performance characteristics must be considered. The model EPD obtains validity through the transfer to the manufacturer by the ift. Currently valid EPDs are to be taken from the list below and are published on www.ift-service.de/epd. EPD number and declaration holder: There are currently no valid EPDs available.
Technical purpose of product or process: Door systems in aluminium for all building classes.
General comment on data set: Aluminium profiles with installation depths 65 mm, 82 mm and 93 mm. Face widths from 50 mm to 250 mm. A1-A3 as well as modules A4, A5, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7, C1, C2, C3, C4, D. The environmental profile includes the expenditures for the life cycle stages cradle to gate with options (module A1-A3). The production of the packaging was taken into account within modules A1-A3.
Technology description including backgro: The LCA results include the life cycle stages of the pre-products manufacture to the point of the raw material extraction and processing of secondary material input (e.g. recycling processes), their transport to the manufacturer as well as the maufacturing itself, including provision of all operating supplies, energy and the complete waste treatment or the landfill of residual waste during the stage of manufacture. The modules A1, A2 and A3 are shown here as an aggregated module A1-A3. If further modules have been calculated for this dataset, these can be found separately and can be merged for consideration of the entire life cycle.
